$comment: Bounded, committed waiver for the Production E2E gate.
RULES ENFORCED BY scripts/e2e-gate.mjs (not by convention):
1. A waived test still RUNS. Nothing is skipped or deleted.
2. Past `expires`, the gate FAILS on the waiver itself. It cannot rot.
3. A waived test that starts PASSING fails the gate until it is removed
— unless it is marked `unstable`, which means it is waived precisely
because it flaps, so a green run proves nothing.
4. Any failure NOT listed here fails the gate normally.
5. The window is capped at 30 days and the policy path is hard-coded in
the script: no CLI override, no env var, no runtime widening.
Baseline: Production E2E had never been green — 0 successes in 405 runs
since 2026-05-17. main @ b2ee7c88 = 57 failed / 177 passed / 24 skipped.
2026-08-13, second pass: the three clusters that needed a product decision
were investigated and FIXED, so they are removed from this waiver:
ide-light-theme (6)     -> the IDE light theme is NOT broken and the IDE is
NOT dark-only. Traced live: cookie + reload holds
data-theme=light and --vc-ide-bg-app=#f6f8fb for
30s. The tests were seeding localStorage only,
which cannot beat the SSR dark fallback.
ide-command-palette (3) -> the palettes work. /command-palette entries are
<Link role="option"> inside a listbox, so
getByRole('link') could never match; the IDE
add-tab trigger needed a retried click.
auth (1)                -> real product bug: the sign-out <Form> was wrapped
in <Popover.Close asChild>, so Radix's close
handler landed on the Form and unmounted it while
the POST was dispatching.
What remains is instability, not a decision: the failing subset moved on every
run of identical code. The mobile matrix measurement has been made convergent;
these entries stay one more cycle to confirm.
